relationships.description: HIV/Borrelia immunomodulation and serologic behavior bridge directly to immune/WBC-disruption mechanisms.
The syphilis analogy props up the Lyme persistence/long-treatment argument that arthritis data partly falsify.
The engineered Lyme/HIV/syphilis-triad conspiracy routes to the bioweapon topic; documented as a claim, not endorsed.
Neurosyphilis's psychiatric manifestations are the historical template for spirochetal neuropsychiatry (mood, suicidality, dementia).
